topic_anchors.paraphrase: The speaker distinguishes behavior that no longer accomplishes anything from still-capable behavior that earns a low return by pursuing the wrong goal.
Coin position is fixed at the right end during training, then randomized on evaluation. The tested agent passes the coin and proceeds to the end.
The agent avoids obstacles and reliably navigates to the end. It earns little reward because it ignores the coin.
